title: The First Rain
description: A corporate manager turns down an executive promotion to save his late grandfather's neglected orchard.

scenes.narration: Henry held the executive promotion contract in his hands, complete with a six-figure salary increase. Yet looking down at the paper, he felt a strange, suffocating weight.
scenes.visual: A man in a sleek business suit holding paper documents inside a tall glass office building

scenes.narration: That weekend, he drove back to his hometown and walked through his late grandfather's neglected apple orchard.
scenes.visual: A man walking through rows of gnarled, unpruned apple trees under gray skies

scenes.narration: The trees were overgrown and wild, but beneath the fallen branches, new green buds were desperately fighting to bloom.
scenes.visual: Close-up of small vibrant green leaf buds on a weathered brown tree branch

scenes.narration: He remembered his grandfather teaching him how to prune branches so sunlight could reach the heart of the tree.
scenes.visual: Hands using wooden pruning shears to trim away a dry dead branch from a tree

scenes.narration: He called his CEO on Monday morning and respectfully declined the promotion, resigning to move back to the valley.
scenes.visual: A man standing outdoors taking off his tie while looking at distant green hills

scenes.narration: As the autumn rain began to fall over the orchard, Henry felt cool water on his face and a deep sense of relief.
scenes.visual: A man standing peacefully in a lush green orchard as gentle rain drops fall around him

scenes.narration: Success isn't about climbing higher, it's about putting down deeper roots. Follow along for more stories of self-discovery.
scenes.visual: A content middle-aged man holding a wooden basket filled with fresh red apples

character_reference: A man in his mid-thirties with a lean build, short-cropped dark brown hair, wearing a navy blue wool overcoat over a crisp white button-down shirt.
